infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: TrailGuard uses your location to track hike routes and broadcast GPS coordinates during emergencies.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: TrailGuard monitors your GPS location in the background during active hikes to record emergency coordinates if a fall occurs.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: TrailGuard maintains a Bluetooth Low Energy link with your wearable in the background to monitor vitals and detect sudden fall impacts.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: TrailGuard pairs with smart wearable sensors via BLE.
